title: Blood Pulse Breaks Through
next_chapter_hook: After the match, a cold voice rang by Chen Ji's ear: 'Is it interesting, being my opponent?' — Su Qingyao officially appeared to strike up a conversation.

text.content: Just as Chen Ji was about to be defeated, the dormant bloodline power within him suddenly awakened — that force actually resonated with the Tianji Record Fragment. A ghostly blue light burst forth from his chest, like a giant beast that had slumbered for ten thousand years opening its eyes. At the same time, the Tianji Record Fragment violently trembled in his Mental Sea, countless ancient runes cascading down like a waterfall, merging with that bloodline power.

Chen Ji felt his entire meridian network burning like fire, as if thousands of needles were simultaneously piercing every inch of skin. The excruciating pain of bloodline awakening—yet he didn't collapse. Instead, amid the agony, he sensed an unprecedented power surging through his body. This was the bloodline of the founding patriarch of the Tianqing Sect! That extraordinary expert who once suppressed the Demonic Path single-handedly was actually his ancestor!

dialogue.content: 'Excellent! Excellent! Excellent!' Mr. Mo's remnant soul in his Mental Sea let out an excited roar, 'I waited three hundred years for this moment! Chen Ji, the sealed bloodline power within you has finally awakened! The resonance between the Tianqing bloodline and the Tianji Record... hahaha, the arrangement from back then was not in vain!'

text.content: Chen Ji had no time to ponder the deeper meaning behind Mr. Mo's words. The surging power within him compelled him to let out a long howl toward the heavens. That ghostly blue light pierced through his body, shooting straight into the clouds, forming a brilliant pillar of light above the Arena. The entire crowd erupted! Everyone stared in disbelief—this was the废物 they had mocked for three years, the servant disciple whose spiritual roots were deemed worthless, now radiating an aura that made all the geniuses present tremble!

dialogue.content: 'Impossible!' Han Lie, the number one prodigy of the Xuanwu Sect, leaped to his feet, his usual arrogance replaced by shock. He stared at the pillar of light, fists clenched so tight his knuckles turned white, 'That's... the Tianqing bloodline?! And a complete awakening?! How is this possible!'

text.content: Fifth Elder Han Canghai's face turned deathly pale in an instant. He leapt to his feet, his broad sleeves catching the wind, eyes wide with terror and disbelief. 'Tianqing bloodline... complete awakening...' His voice trembled, 'This means... he's not just a disciple of the Tianqing Sect, he's... a direct bloodline descendant!' The entire Arena fell into dead silence, every gaze focused on that pillar of light.

Within the pillar of light, Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes. Those eyes were no longer the unremarkable ones from before, but glowing with ghostly blue light, as deep as the starry sky, seeming capable of seeing through all illusions in the world. His aura was rising visibly—Qi Refining seventh stage, eighth stage, ninth stage—finally stopping at early Foundation Building. But that pressure far exceeded ordinary early Foundation Building!

At this moment, Zhao Yuanqi, the seed disciple who had been suppressing Chen Ji on the arena platform, was forced back several zhang by that overwhelming pressure, his face pale, the hand gripping his sword trembling violently. His gaze at Chen Ji held no more contempt—only pure fear. 'You... you've been hiding your strength all along?!' Zhao Yuanqi's voice shook.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji gave no answer. He slowly raised his hand and flicked his finger. A ghostly blue sword qi burst from his fingertip, so fast that Zhao Yuanqi's protective spiritual light couldn't react in time. That sword qi directly shattered Zhao Yuanqi's protective spiritual light, sending his entire body flying off the arena platform, crashing heavily over thirty feet away, unconscious.

text.content: The entire arena fell deathly silent. A prestigious inner sect seed disciple, defeated in one move by the废物 they had mocked for three years! This wasn't a match—it was a crushing, total domination! The referee elder stood frozen for at least three breaths before finally reacting, announcing with a trembling voice: 'The... the match is over! Chen Ji... wins!' The words fell, and the entire Arena erupted into a mountain-and-sea-like wave of discussion.

choice.prompt: You defeated your former opponent in a single move, and now all eyes are on you, the Fifth Elder's face is livid, Han Lie is furious. This is a moment to declare your existence to everyone—how will you respond to this earth-shaking reversal?

choices.description: Publicly announce: From this day forth, no one may call me废物 again. Let everyone hear your voice clearly.
choices.visible_reward: Reputation greatly increased, deterring the weak
choices.risk_hint: A tree that stands out among the forest will surely be destroyed by the wind

text.content: Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, ghostly blue light swirling around him. He surveyed his surroundings, his gaze finally landing on the livid Fifth Elder, a cold smile curling at the corner of his lips. He spoke, his voice not loud, yet clearly reaching everyone's ears:

dialogue.content: 'From this day forth, no one may call me废物.' Just eight short characters, yet they rang like thunder in everyone's ears. Having said this, he turned and walked down from the arena platform, his back view solitary and resolute. The entire crowd fell silent, then erupted into even more intense discussion—废物? That was a Tianqing bloodline awakener! That was an extraordinary genius who could defeat a seed disciple in a single move!

choices.description: Coldly look at the Fifth Elder: You once said I didn't even have spiritual roots worth mentioning. What do you have to say for yourself now?
choices.visible_cost: Completely make an enemy of the Fifth Elder's faction
choices.visible_reward: Thoroughly slap their faces, readers will be extremely satisfied

text.content: Chen Ji did not leave the Arena Platform. He turned around, his gaze like a blade, piercing directly at Fifth Elder Han Canghai's seat. "Elder Han," his voice was terrifyingly calm, "Three years ago, you publicly declared that even my spiritual root was worthless, unfit for cultivation. Today..." He spread open both hands, and a ghostly blue light swirled within his palms, "What explanation do you have?"

choices.description: Smile indifferently: Just lucky. Slip away quietly before anyone can react.
choices.visible_reward: Stay low-key, letting enemies lower their guard
choices.risk_hint: Might be seen as a stroke of luck

text.content: Chen Ji simply smiled nonchalantly, the smile carrying a hint of self-mockery and disdain. "Just lucky." He said softly, turning to descend the Arena Platform, as if everything that just happened was merely an insignificant victory. His low-key demeanor left everyone stunned—the awakening of Tianqing bloodline, defeating the enemy in one move, and this was merely "luck"?

choices.text: Coldly sweep gaze across the entire arena
choices.description: Don't speak, just look at those who once mocked you with your eyes, then leave. Silent contempt is the most lethal.
choices.visible_cost: Might be thought of as arrogant
choices.visible_reward: Establish an invincible momentum, causing enemies' psychology to collapse

text.content: Chen Ji did not speak. He slowly raised his eyes, his gaze like a cold blade, sweeping across the faces of those disciples who had once mocked him coldly. That gaze was too calm, so calm it sent chills. Those swept by his gaze involuntarily lowered their heads, not daring to meet his eyes. By the time he turned and left, the entire Arena was shrouded in an eerie silence.

Among the crowd, Su Qingyao stood quietly in a corner. She had come to watch the fun, after all, a match between a废物 and a seeded contender really had no看点. Yet at this moment, gazing at Chen Ji's departing back, a glint of something unusual flashed in her eyes. "Interesting..." she murmured to herself, a playful smile curling at her lips, "You've hidden yourself well, Chen Ji."

Above on the high platform, Tianqing Sect's veteran Patriarch Ling Yuan's gaze was profound like an abyss. He watched Chen Ji's departing back, a complex gleam flickering in his eyes. "Tianqing bloodline..." he murmured, his voice so low only he could hear, "Three hundred years ago, that layout—was it truly going to be fulfilled in this generation?" He lifted his teacup, took a light sip, and a flash of killing intent vanished from his eyes.

dialogue.content: Within the Mental Sea, Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out again: "Kid, the bloodline awakening today is merely the beginning. The resonance between this Tianqing bloodline and the Tianji Record Fragment in your body shows that your fate with the Tianji Record runs far deeper than I imagined. But remember—" his tone suddenly turned grave, "The more complete the Tianji Record, the stronger the deadly backlash of fate. Now that your bloodline has awakened, the second page of the Tianji Record has begun to loosen..."

text.content: Chen Ji was about to ask what the second page was when he found his consciousness severed by Mo Xiansheng. He furrowed his brows but did not press—Mo Xiansheng's rules he understood: what should be said will be said, asking what shouldn't be asked is pointless. He gathered his thoughts and returned along the small path to the Outer Disciple residence. Night wind blew past, lifting his robes. The battle just now was merely a beginning for him.

However, just as Chen Ji was about to step into the Outer Disciple residence, a clear and cold voice suddenly sounded in his ear. That voice was like ice spring striking stone, cold yet carrying an indescribable interest: "Is it fun being my opponent?" Chen Ji's footsteps abruptly stopped. He looked up to see a woman in a blue silk dress leaning against the doorframe, moonlight falling upon her, outlining a face of cold, breathtaking beauty—Su Qingyao, the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow of Tianqing Sect, the only person who had noticed something wrong with him.

dialogue.content: "Senior Sister Su visits so late at night, I wonder what brings you here?" Chen Ji's expression held no波动, as if standing before him was merely an ordinary fellow disciple. Yet his mind was already racing rapidly—Su Qingyao had come, this was something he had anticipated long ago. After all, in the entire Tianqing Sect, she was the only person who would not underestimate him based on his outward appearance.

Su Qingyao walked closer step by step, under the moonlight she was breathtakingly beautiful, yet so cold that people dared not approach. "Three years," she stopped three feet in front of Chen Ji, looking at him with a knowing smile, "You've hidden yourself so deeply, Chen Ji. No—" she paused, a playful glint flickering in her eyes, "What should I call you then?废物?天才? Or... something else?"

choice.prompt: Su Qingyao has three times come infinitely close to the truth, and you have resolved it three times. This time, her gaze is keener than ever before. How do you choose to deal with this genius-level investigator?

choices.description: An innocent face: Senior Sister Su, what are you talking about? Little brother really doesn't understand.
choices.visible_cost: She may suspect you even more
choices.risk_hint: She already suspects; it's hard to deceive her.

dialogue.content: "What is Su Senior Sister saying?" Chen Ji scratched his head, wearing an innocent expression. "Today I just got lucky, that's all—the bloodline happened to awaken. What do you mean by hiding something deep? I really don't understand." As he spoke, he even revealed a simple, honest smile, as if he truly were a foolish young man who had accidentally exposed his strength.

choices.description: Acknowledge having secrets but emphasize no harm to her: Su Senior Sister, I do have troubles I cannot speak of, but I bear you absolutely no ill will.
choices.visible_cost: Expose the fact that you have secrets
choices.visible_reward: May gain her understanding or even assistance
choices.risk_hint: May make her want to know the truth even more

dialogue.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then raised his head, meeting Su Qingyao's gaze directly. "Su Senior Sister," his voice was calm and sincere, "I do have matters I cannot speak of. But there is one thing I can tell you—I bear no malice toward you, nor toward the Tianqing Sect." He paused, "As for the rest... please give me some time."

choices.description: Coldly counter-question: Su Senior Sister, when did you start paying attention to me? If you want answers, trade your secrets for mine.
choices.visible_reward: Let her know you're not easily bullied

dialogue.content: Chen Ji suddenly smiled, that smile carrying a hint of coldness. "Su Senior Sister," he said unhurriedly, "when did you start paying attention to me?" He stepped forward, locking eyes with Su Qingyao, "Want answers? Trade your secrets for mine."

choices.description: Lay your cards on the table directly: I know you've been investigating me—yes, I'm not a废物. But my secrets are too great; are you certain you wish to know?
choices.risk_hint: Once spoken, it cannot be taken back

dialogue.content: "Su Senior Sister," Chen Ji's expression suddenly turned serious, "I know you've been investigating me. That's right—" he stared directly into Su Qingyao's eyes, every word precise, "I am not a废物. But my secrets are too great; are you certain you wish to know?"

Su Qingyao slightly narrowed her eyes, studying the man before her. Beneath the moonlight, his aura was unfathomable—that composed, almost cold gaze stirred an odd sensation in her heart—as if standing before her was not an outer disciple/servant, but a chess player plotting dominion over the world. She laughed softly: "Interesting." She stepped forward, the distance between her and Chen Ji suddenly narrowing, "Since you won't speak, then I'll wait. Until the day you're willing to open your mouth—" her voice suddenly dropped, carrying a hint of intimacy only the two of them could hear, "After all, those who can be my opponents are few and far between in this world."

text.content: With that, Su Qingyao turned and departed, her blue skirts swaying gently in the night breeze. However, just as she was about to vanish into the darkness, she suddenly looked back, moonlight illuminating her coldly beautiful visage. "By the way," her voice drifted from afar, "The Inner Sect Selection in three days—I look forward to your performance." The words fell, and she had already transformed into a blue shadow, disappearing into the night. Chen Ji stood in place, gazing at the direction of her departure, a meaningful curve forming at the corner of his lips.

The night wind brushed past, carrying a chill. Chen Ji raised his eyes to the sky, the starlight dim, as if presaging the incoming storm. After this night, the entire Tianqing Sect would know his name. And he would make this name an inescapable nightmare for all his enemies. "Su Qingyao..." he murmured, a complex gleam flickering in his eyes, "Three times now—you've come infinitely close to the truth. This time, how much do you wish to know?" He laughed softly, turned, and stepped into his dwelling, closing the door behind him. Outside, the night deepened like ink.
